pressure_to_load.reference_definition: Each case: area-weighted mean pressure on the lower common material surface. Gauge-invariant referenced open-region load, not a uniquely defined physical fin load. Remainder accounts for finite-thickness geometry, unpaired elements and interpolation.

paired_normal_budget.scope: Negative-z fin; jointly valid upper/lower material-chart pairs; paired pressure-jump load proxy, not total fin or whole-system force.

central_derivative_sensitivity.scope: Negative-z fin; jointly valid upper/lower material-chart pairs; paired pressure-jump load proxy, not total fin or whole-system force.

body_geometry.limitation: Checks shared vertex trajectories only; unmatched vertices may reflect tessellation or geometry differences; full-surface kinematic equivalence is not established by this check.

transport.viscosity_provenance: Available picar_in/Sweep_35/input.dat: Re=41379.3, U=.29, dt=1/480. Run-copy identity is not independently archived; viscous term is conditional on this setup.

attribution.scope: Audit of previously computed potentials and transport windows, not new elliptic solves or new trajectory integration. Old target is a negative-z fin regional load under its original reference convention, not the current closed-system interaction.
